name: field-closure-foundation
objective: Repair the field verification foundation and strict package contract before any feature is claimed closed.
truthOwner: Current BB source and executable tests are implementation truth; Product Truth bounds field scope.

tasks.objective: Make the canonical app-field test command execute real field behavioral tests and fail on field regressions.
tasks.currentProblem: The current test script targets a nonexistent src/__tests__ path, so the field-specific gate is not a trustworthy closure signal.
tasks.requiredChange: Create or point to an authoritative app-field test suite and wire it into the canonical test command together with the existing runtime-contract gate.
tasks.targetState: A green app-field test command proves field tests actually ran on the exact candidate SHA; no-test execution is a failure.
tasks.action: Add focused tests around current field readiness/navigation/session composition, update package scripts without weakening generic runtime contracts, and bind closure evidence to the canonical command.
mustNotChange: Do not use pass-with-no-tests or skip flags.
Do not add tests for unrelated apps.
Do not weaken generic mobile runtime checks.
acceptanceCriteria: The test target exists and contains real field tests.
The canonical test command runs field tests and the generic runtime contract.
A deliberately failing field test makes the command fail.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused test-wiring change if it regresses unrelated scripts; preserve proven runtime checks.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused foundation commit after all required checks pass.
